title: NAB Protects and Recovers Rs. 241 Billion in Assets
excerpt: The National Accountability Bureau Islamabad/Rawalpindi has helped recover and protect national assets worth about Rs. 241.408 billion in two months.
body_html:
The National Accountability Bureau (NAB) Islamabad/Rawalpindi has successfully facilitated the recovery and safeguarding of national assets valued at approximately Rs. 241.408 billion.

According to the recent updates, these achievements were recorded over a period of two months. The bureau's actions focused on protecting state resources and recovering valuable assets for the country.
